title: Rate Desk Q&A — The Unit Cost Savings are Valued At, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Unit Cost Savings are Valued At

Questions answered by the rate desk on the unit cost applied when savings are verified on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions.

## Rule

Where the tier keeps the site's utility rate structure current and a billed reading was posted on the subscription in the month ending on the day of the verification, the unit cost is the average unit cost of the billed readings of the twelve months ending on that day. Where the tier keeps the site's utility rate structure current and no billed reading was posted in that month, the unit cost is the unit cost of the latest billed reading standing on the subscription. Where the tier does not keep the site's utility rate structure current, the unit cost is the average unit cost of the billed readings of the twenty-four months ending on that day, so that a rate change the analyst is not tracking is smoothed over two years.

## Questions

**What is an average unit cost over a window?** The cost recorded on the billed readings of that window, totalled, divided by the electricity those same readings recorded.

**What is the unit cost of a single reading?** The cost recorded on that reading divided by the electricity it recorded. The latest billed reading is the one posted most recently on the subscription.

**A tier that keeps the rate structure current, with a billed reading posted in the last month.** The average over the 12 months ending on the day of the verification.

**The same tier with no billed reading posted in that month.** The unit cost of the latest billed reading standing on the subscription, whenever it was posted.

**A tier that does not keep the rate structure current.** The average over the 24 months ending on that day, whether or not a reading was posted in the last month.

## Summary

| Rate structure kept current | Billed reading posted in the month ending on the day of the verification | Unit cost |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the average of the billed readings of the last 12 months |
| yes | no | the unit cost of the latest billed reading standing |
| no | any | the average of the billed readings of the last 24 months |
